papers_read.title_as_printed: Explainable Machine Learning with Pairwise Interactions for Predicting Conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Utilizing Multi-Modalities Data (Cai et al.; Brain Sci. 2023, 13, 1535)

Assessing clinical progression from subjective cognitive decline to mild cognitive impairment with incomplete multi-modal neuroimages (Liu, Yue, Xiao, Yang, Shen, Liu; Medical Image Analysis 75 (2022) 102266)

what_each_reports.P-211: ADNI 1/2/3/GO amnestic MCI (1042 at baseline); Explainable Boosting Machine on tabular features (FreeSurfer regional volumes/thickness, ADAS13, MMSE, FAQ, CDR-SB, demographics, baseline EMCI/LMCI, APOE4); 5-fold CV. Five-year conversion: accuracy 85%, AUC 0.92 (225 participants remaining at 5 years). Three-year comb-a model with interactions: accuracy 0.75, AUC 0.81 (test data).
what_each_reports.P-93: Primary task is SCD-to-MCI conversion (CLAS, 76 SCD, 7-year follow-up; JSRL AUC 0.747). Secondary task (Section 4.3): pMCI vs sMCI with a 36-month window on ADNI-1/2, trained on 939 subjects with MRI + FDG-PET (sCN/sMCI negative, pMCI/AD positive) and tested on independent MCI subjects with MRI only (PET synthesised by a GAN): AUC 0.838, ACC 0.780.

quantity_a: AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 5 years, ADNI amnestic MCI, cognitive scores + regional MRI volumes + demographics/APOE4, 5-fold CV.
quantity_b: AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 36 months, ADNI-1/2, whole-brain T1 MRI images with GAN-synthesised FDG-PET features (no cognitive or demographic inputs), single held-out independent MCI test set.
incompatible_if_same: No. At the matched three-year horizon P-211 reports AUC 0.81, close to P-93's 0.838. Neither paper evaluates the other's method or claims an ordering the other refutes.

gates.task: match in label (MCI-to-AD conversion, T2) for P-93's secondary task, but horizons differ (5 years vs 36 months); P-93's headline task is SCD-to-MCI, a different transition
gates.validation_tier: match: both internal (5-fold CV vs ADNI held-out test set), V2
gates.modality_family: mismatch: P-211 is tabular MRI measures plus neuropsychological scores and APOE4; P-93 is MRI images with synthetic FDG-PET, no cognitive data; the record sets modality_family_equal 'No'

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric type (ROC AUC) but different horizons (5-year vs 3-year conversion) and different predictor sets and input representations (tabular cognitive + volumetric features vs voxel images).
performance_validity: flag does not apply: 0.92 and 0.838 are below 0.97.
independence: Distinct author groups (Xi'an Jiaotong vs UNC/Southern Medical University/Shanghai); both use ADNI MCI participants and may overlap.
grounds: P-211's AUC 0.92 is for conversion within five years, whereas P-93's AUC 0.838 is for conversion within 36 months.
P-211 relies on cognitive scores, demographics and APOE4 alongside regional MRI volumes, whereas P-93 uses MRI images with synthesised PET only, so predictor sets and input representations differ.
At the matched three-year horizon P-211 reports AUC 0.81, which does not disagree with P-93's 0.838.

evidence_quotes.quote: The five-years prediction accuracy reached 85% (AUC = 0.92) using both cognitive scores and MRI markers.
The main performance indicators, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and AUC, were 0.75, 0.78, 0.73, and 0.81 (with interaction effects)
we use the 36-month window to define the conversion of SCD and MCI subjects in ADNI-1 and ADNI-2.
Figure 4 suggests that our JSRL achieves the best AUC of 0.838 and ACC of 0.780
we used only neuroimaging data for prediction, without considering the demographic information (e.g., age, gender, and education)

record_defects: claim_b is still written as 'P-188: AUC 0.838 on T2' although paper_b was repointed from the duplicate stub P-188 to P-93 on 2026-09-16.
claim_a 'AUC 0.92 on T2' omits the five-year horizon; the three-year AUC in P-211 is 0.81.
Registry Sample_N_Approx '242804' for P-211 is impossible (1042 MCI participants).
P-93's own MCI test-set size is inconsistent (text: 177 = 81 sMCI + 96 pMCI; Table 2 and Table 5: 66 sMCI / 93 pMCI); the AUC 0.838 is not affected.
resolution_note says 'Confirmed genuine' while resolution says 'Rejected: Task, dataset, or modality mismatch' and the status is partially_resolved_candidate: internally inconsistent.
what_would_change_the_verdict: A three-year P-211 AUC with a matched (imaging-only) predictor set whose uncertainty excluded 0.838; the paper reports no such figure.
